test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following organisations was established in 1885?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian National Congress.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian National Congress** was established in **1885** by **Allan Octavian Hume, Dadabhai Naoroji, Dinshaw Wacha,** and others.
 
• The Indian National Congress aimed to unite and** mobilize the Indian people **against British colonial rule and to promote** Indian interests and rights.**
 
• In addition to leading India's **independence from the UK,** the Congress had a big impact on other** anti-colonial nationalist movements** throughout the British Empire.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Communist Party of India **was founded in **1925** and was influenced by** Marxist-Leninist ideology.**

 
 
• It played a significant role in the **Indian independence movement **and** subsequent politics.**
 
 
 
• **Muslim League** was established in **1906** to represent the interests of **Indian Muslims**, who feared marginalization in the predominantly Hindu Congress.
 
 
• The League later demanded a **separate Muslim state**, which led to the **partition of India in 1947.**
 
 
 
• The **East India Company **was a **British trading and colonial organization** that played a major role in India from the 1600s to the 1800s.
 
 
• However, the Company was **dissolved in 1858**, well before 1885.
